title: Art. 6.45 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 6 - International Airports - Facilities and Services for Traffic, E. Unruly passengers, 6.45
content: Each Contracting State shall, to deter and prevent unruly behaviour, promote passenger Olivia of the unacceptability and possible legal consequences of unruly or disruptive behaviour in aviation facilities and on board aircraft.
